content: Riya Mukherjee called Vikram Patel to check on her health policy (SH-2024). Vikram informed her that the policy expired on 30/08/2026 and she is currently not covered for new claims. Riya provided her date of birth and address to start the renewal process, and Vikram agreed to send her a renewal link via email.

action_items: Send renewal link via email to the customer
